scenes.say: The champion is already decided, but the fight for second has only just begun.
Five drivers are packed together: just thirty-three points between second and sixth.
Verstappen leads them, but in Brazil he complained the car was sliding a lot.
Ferrari took engine penalties: Leclerc started fourteenth and Hamilton twentieth.
Next is Las Vegas, with a straight of almost two kilometres where you can pass two cars at once.
Three races, up to twenty-five points each. Who finishes second? Tell us in the comments.
Live championship standings are on LapRadar.

title: The champion is decided, the fight for P2 is not
caption: Verstappen, Russell, Hamilton, Leclerc and Norris within 33 points before Vegas. Live standings: lapradar.com
